verdict.rationale: LlamaIndex explicitly documents self-hosted/BYOC deployment of LlamaCloud (including LlamaParse) as an enterprise option, keeping data and infrastructure under user control, which directly satisfies the self-hosting story. However, this is positioned as an enterprise-tier offering rather than an openly available self-host path for any AI-native user, and there is no evidence of open-source code, container images, or a public self-hosting guide/setup instructions. Missing for 10: publicly available deployment artifacts (Docker/Helm/source), pricing/access details for non-enterprise self-hosting, and independent confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment.
